issues.description: Mismatch between the problem statement and the provided template/solution for Aufgabe 01: The problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires four output columns: Zoo.name, Zoo.url (Internetadresse), Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql) currently selects only Zoo.name and Gemeinde.name. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) selects Zoo.name and Zoo.url but omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. This inconsistency (presence/absence of the Gemeinde columns and the url column in the template) will confuse students about the expected SELECT output columns and which columns the canonical solution should produce.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template and the solution consistent with the task description. Update both files so the SELECT list includes all requested columns: Zoo.name, Zoo.url (Internetadresse), Gemeinde.name, and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk, and include the join condition. Example canonical query to use in both template and solution: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name AS Gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; If the template is meant to be a starter, include a partial query with a comment prompting the student to add the missing columns and join, but ensure the provided solution file matches the problem statement exactly.
